literalGroups.primaryGround: The question asks for one English headword with both explicitly named noun senses; Merriam-Webster gives coat sense 1a as an outer garment and sense 3 as a covering layer, with paint as example. This tests a lexical fact, not an exclusive physical garment trait.

literalGroups.primaryGround: Both clauses restate the two listed Merriam-Webster noun senses and the page’s coat-of-paint example; no claim is made that those senses are exclusive to clothing.
